description: How clean and how expensive the electricity is on the power grids GPU hosts sit on (Europe, Great Britain, the US): carbon intensity now, its low and high over the last 24 hours and when, the hour of day that is usually cleanest, the day-ahead wholesale power price now and the cheapest hour in the next 24. Use it to choose where or when to run a job that can wait. The grid_zone values match the grid_zone on find_offers results.

grid_zone.description: One grid by id, e.g. SE-SE3, DE, US-TEX-ERCO

limit.description: Maximum number of grids to return, after sorting. total_matching says how many there are in all.

region_filter.description: Only grids in these ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries, e.g. ['SE','NO']

sort_by.description: carbon: cleanest first. power_price: cheapest day-ahead price first.

name: grid_carbon

snapshot.description: Hour the readings refer to, UTC

carbon_age_h.description: Hours since that reading. US grids run about a day behind.

carbon_doubtful.description: A reading in the last day is far below this grid's usual level; treat the 24 h low with care

carbon_g_kwh.description: gCO2eq per kWh generated in the zone, latest reading

carbon_uncertain.description: A tenth or more of generation had no fuel type; the mix is partly assumed

power_price_usd_mwh.description: Day-ahead wholesale price for the snapshot hour; can be negative

usual_cleanest_hour.description: Hour of day (UTC) with the lowest average over the last 7 days

title: Power grid carbon and price
